# Funnel Leak Finder

`funnel-leak-finder` · v1.0.0 · Diagnose · Analytics & Experimentation
<!-- Generated by platform/scripts/generate-engine-specs.mjs from skills/funnel-leak-finder/spec.json and SKILL.md. Do not edit. -->

**Decision it supports:** Which funnel stage cost us the most wins this period, against last period or our own targets, and is that change real or noise?

**Inputs:** This period's funnel counts (sessions, leads, MQLs, SQLs, opportunities, wins; at least 3 consecutive stages), and a baseline - last period's counts or your target rate per stage, with where the targets come from; optionally revenue per win

**Output:** Each stage's rate against its baseline in points and relative terms, the wins (and revenue) each shortfall cost, the stages ranked, the leak named, a noise check per stage, and a plain statement when no baseline was given

**Setup:**
- Install the skill: `npx skills add sarojkjha/aaj-marketing-skills --skill funnel-leak-finder`
- Or connect the hosted MCP server, no install: `https://aaj-engines-mcp.sarojkjha10.workers.dev/mcp`
- Or run the local MCP server: node platform/mcp/server.mjs (Node 18 or newer)
- Input schema: the comment at the top of `skills/funnel-leak-finder/resources/funnel-leak.js` (the MCP server's describe_engine shows it). Worked example: `node skills/funnel-leak-finder/resources/funnel-leak.js --demo`.
- Agents listed: Claude Code, Cursor, OpenAI Codex, Windsurf, Cline. Tested and recorded: Claude Code, OpenAI Codex (Windows, ab-test-significance only).

**Acts or analyzes:** Analyzes only. The engine makes no network calls, writes no files and changes nothing in your tools; it returns text and JSON.

**Where your information goes:**

| How you run it | Where your inputs go |
|---|---|
| Skill installed in your agent, or the local MCP server | The engine runs on your machine and AAJ receives nothing. Your AI agent still sends what you give it to its model provider (Anthropic, OpenAI and so on), under your own account's terms. |
| Hosted MCP server | Your agent's model provider, as above, plus AAJ's server on Cloudflare, which receives the engine inputs over HTTPS, runs them in memory and keeps no copy. Cloudflare keeps error logs (no inputs) for up to 7 days. |

No engine needs customer names, emails or other personal data; leave them out.

**Limitations:**
- No baseline, no leak: without last period's counts or your own target rates the engine shows the stage rates and names nothing, because raw drop-off cannot say where wins were lost.
- Each stage's wins lost holds the other stages at this period's rates, so the figures do not add up to the total change in wins.
- Counts in one period are not one cohort: wins this quarter partly come from opportunities created earlier. With a long sales cycle, compare longer or lagged periods.
- The noise check treats each count as an independent trial. Sessions are not people, so for sessions to leads it overstates certainty. The 95% level and the 5-count minimum are AAJ's choices.

**Review before acting:** The marketing and sales leads confirm that the stage definitions (what counts as an MQL, SQL and opportunity) were the same in both periods, and that any target rates come from a plan or source they can name.

Method: [skills.aajconsult.com/skills/funnel-leak-finder](https://skills.aajconsult.com/skills/funnel-leak-finder)
